verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents several built-in AI capabilities you can hand work to. Ask AI answers questions about your inbox, Write with AI turns jotted phrases into full emails in your voice, and Auto Drafts 2.0 drafts replies using context from your inbox, calendar and the web. The Email Assistant also labels, archives and reminds you to follow up, and a chat or visual builder creates proactive, trigger-based agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-product AI features, and clear evidence that the in-app assistant can carry out arbitrary multi-step actions on command (Ask AI is shown mainly as question answering, and multi-step 'one prompt' workflows are documented via external assistants over MCP).
